svg.title: Enterprise Agent Fabric
svg.desc: Agent security and Agent evals sit on the left. Events sits at the top. Agent Fabric Plane sits above Agent Fabric Front Door; Front Door spans the same width as Agent Plane. Agent Fabric Runtime sits to the right of Front Door, then Shared (Memory, RAG, Tools). Chat/UI and API enter only through Agent Fabric Front Door. Front Door asks Agent Data Plane to classify, pins the frozen route/session, then starts Agent Fabric Runtime. Agent Fabric Runtime fetches the route row from Agent Data Plane and hydrates tool metadata from the Agent Fabric Capability Registry. Observability and Agent audit sit side by side at the bottom; both feed Dashboard. Dashboard feeds Responsible / Governed AI.
